mina: FYI rolled v4-alpha-int4 at 08:05 as a 3% canary. infra looks green but our composite degrade index (CDI) for customer_facing_fewshot hit 2.9 in the last window. short_helpfulness MRR down ~2.6% (ctrl=0.321 trt=0.313, n=3,800 each, bootstrap p=0.008). want to lock an automated safety policy before we widen. cc @dahlia @raph

raph: can you paste the CDI definition and the per-metric z-scores?

mina: CDI is the sum of negative z-scores over these primaries: fewshot_mrr_short, longform_mrr, and -hallucination_rate (we invert halluc so increases hurt CDI). last window z-scores: fewshot_mrr_short = -1.95, longform_mrr = -0.6, halluc_inv = -0.35 => CDI = 2.9. raw numbers attached in smoke harness link.

dahlia: agree we need an automated "safety-mesh". proposal: layered ruleset with hysteresis and monotonicity:
- Preconditions: a metric/slice must have >=1000 samples in the 15m window to count.
- Global CDI rule: if CDI >= 2.5 for 3 consecutive 10m windows -> immediate rollback to control, create rollout-audit ticket.
- Slice hard-floor: if any slice MRR relative delta <= -2.0% AND p <= 0.01 AND n >= 2000 across 2 consecutive windows -> rollback.
- Hallucination guard: absolute hallucination increase >= 0.4% AND p <= 0.05 AND monotonic increase across the hysteresis windows -> rollback.
- Investigate-only band: CDI in [1.5,2.5) for 2 consecutive windows -> page SRE/ML but do not rollback.
- Minimum-action throttle: require conditions to persist for 2 windows for slice triggers, 3 for global, to avoid flapping.

mina: makes sense. want the global CDI to be aggressive (it aggregates multiple small hits) but keep slice triggers stricter since they can be noisy.

safety-bot: draft command for the policy:
```
/safety create-policy --model v4-alpha-int4 --name safety-mesh-2024-06 --precond-min-samples 1000 --global-cdi 2.5:3x10m --slice-mrr -0.02:p<=0.01:2x15m:n>=2000 --halluc-abs 0.004:p<=0.05:monotonic:3x15m --investigate 1.5:2x10m --notify #incidents --audit true
```

yuki: +1 to policy but we should shrink traffic now and run a focused A/B smoke suite for customer_facing_fewshot before letting auto-rollback fire. suggest drop to 0.5% and run 50k synthetic fewshot prompts + the live 0.5% to get more power.

raph: agree. also require that any auto-rollback attaches raw sample dumps to the audit ticket (CSV with prompt + outputs + model ids) for product repro. otherwise triage is slow.

dahlia: addendum: if rollback occurs, create a temporary holdout tag on the model version to prevent accidental re-promotes within 24h.

mina: action plan: 1) create the policy (dahlias rules) 2) shrink canary to 0.5% 3) run the targeted smoke harness (fewshot synthetic + live sampling) 4) wait for 2 windows of data or smoke completion, then decide expand vs revert. Ill create the rollout audit ticket and paste links here.

safety-bot: policy created id=safety-mesh-2024-06-279001. will alert #incidents and perform auto-rollback when rules fire. audit export enabled.

yuki: thanks. ping us with the smoke link and the 2-window summary. :thumbsup:

mina: will report back in this thread once smoke finishes and we have the 2-window check. thanks all.
